neighbours.label: the token ' whereby'
fire: They signed an agreement whereby each country would cut its tariffs.
The court described a scheme whereby investors were paid with new deposits.
Plants use a process whereby light energy is stored as sugar.
The law created a system whereby tenants could appeal rent increases.
She proposed an arrangement whereby the twins shared the car on weekends.
This is a mechanism whereby cells remove damaged proteins.
The union won a deal whereby overtime is paid at double rate.
Economists describe a cycle whereby falling prices delay spending.
quiet: They signed an agreement under which each country would cut its tariffs.
The court described a scheme in which investors were paid with new deposits.
Plants use a process by which light energy is stored as sugar.
The law created a system that let tenants appeal rent increases.
She proposed an arrangement where the twins shared the car on weekends.
This is a mechanism through which cells remove damaged proteins.
The union won a deal so that overtime is paid at double rate.
Economists describe a cycle in which falling prices delay spending.

notes: All top 32 peaks are ' whereby'. Near misses use 'in which', 'by which', 'under which' etc.
